title: (AI Game Fun) A16Z Games // Speedrun Discord
author: Internet_Treasure
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/oca74jwdonrd1.png?width=450&format=png&auto=webp&s=cd5242fdbcfba772950030637a74d26e3e574c60

Hey Folks,

Speedrun is an investment firm that specializes in: Game Dev, AI in Games, AI in general, and adjacent categories! Their next batch ends in 12 hours so get your application in if you're building AI Games, AI in Games, or just game studios!

I created it with the intention of connecting with others in the game space, founders who became A16Z portfolio companies, and those who are trying to just break into the space! Come & join our [A16Z Games Discord Community](https://discord.gg/6guRZpx6HC)

I am trying to connect entrepreneurial game developers together where you can:

* Discuss your game ideas
* Practice pitching
* Get feedback on development/raising
* And network with others!

You can join the A16Z Games // SPEEDRUN Community Discord here: [https://discord.gg/6guRZpx6H](https://discord.gg/6guRZpx6HC)

comments.author: Donkeytonk
comments.body: Applied to the last one and didn’t get through. We’re bootstrapping and growing nicely now though.

replies.author: Internet_Treasure
replies.body: Never give up! Did you get to round 2?

replies.author: Donkeytonk
replies.body: After around 2 months I received an email that we weren’t successful. Probably for the best, we’re enjoying bootstrapping and growing decently.

replies.author: Internet_Treasure
replies.body: Oh I see. I will temper my expectations hehe
